title: Vertical Hydroponic Farming: Sustainable Urban Agriculture
reason: Explains the benefits and methods of vertical hydroponic farming.

tasks.task: Describe the emerging trend of vertical hydroponic farming.

subtasks.text: Highlight the increasing demand for locally sourced produce in expanding urban areas.
Outline the challenges faced by traditional farming methods, such as space limitations and dependency on weather.
Introduce vertical hydroponic farming as an innovative solution to these challenges.
Explain how vertical hydroponic farming optimizes space and resource use.
Discuss the environmental benefits of vertical hydroponic farming, such as reduced water usage and carbon emissions.

tasks.task: Provide an overview of different types of vertical hydroponic systems.

subtasks.text: Describe the characteristics and advantages of tower systems for growing herbs, strawberries, and leafy greens.
Explain the design and functionality of A-Frame systems, emphasizing their efficient space utilization and light exposure.
Introduce the Nutrient Film Technique (NFT) system and its suitability for fast-growing greens.
